title: Text Message Marketing for Local Businesses

segments.narration: Nine out of ten business texts get opened.
The average customer reads a business text within 90 seconds of receiving it. That window is faster than any other marketing channel. At the cost of a text message, nothing else even comes close.

segments.title: Message Channel Open and Reach Rates
segments.narration: SMS reaches 98 percent of customers who receive it. Email gets 22 percent. Facebook organic posts reach about 5 percent of your followers. Text is not just another channel. It is the one that actually reaches people.

Text messages get a 45 percent response rate compared to 6 percent for email. For every 100 customers you reach, nearly half respond. No other channel at this price point comes close to that kind of engagement.

Before you send a single marketing text, you need explicit written consent. The Telephone Consumer Protection Act requires it. Fines run up to $1,500 per message for violations. Getting opt-in right is the foundation the whole system sits on.

Three methods work reliably. A checkbox at checkout with clear disclosure language. A keyword opt-in where the customer texts a word to your number. Or a paper sign-up sheet at the counter for service businesses where the customer is on-site.

The first message goes out same day or next morning. No promotion. Just a direct line back to a real person. This message generates replies 20 to 30 percent of the time. Every reply is a chance to solve a problem before it becomes a negative review.

Message two fires on day three or four with a specific offer. Ten percent off your next visit works. Come back soon does not. Give them a concrete reason with a loose deadline. A yes reply books itself.

The third message fires at day 28 to 30. One-word reply, no friction. A customer who had a good experience a month ago and has not been contacted since is far more likely to rebook. You are reminding someone who already chose you.

Opt-out rates stay below 2 percent when businesses send four or fewer texts per month. The 3-message sequence keeps you well within that range. More than that and opt-out rates climb fast, damaging your list permanently.

SimpleTexting starts at $29 a month for 500 texts. EZTexting runs around $24. Write three message templates once and they run automatically after every new opt-in. The only manual work is replying to the conversations they start.
